mapper.sql: JOIN TB_BID_RSLT R ON R.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND R.BID_RSLT_CD IN ('BR010', 'BR020')
mapper.select: SELECT TEAM_SN AS teamSn, TEAM_NM AS teamNm FROM TB_TEAM WHERE DEPT_CD = 'DP030' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY TEAM_SN
SELECT U.TEAM_SN FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = U.TEAM_SN WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId} AND T.DEPT_CD = 'DP030' AND T.USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY') FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE AND P.BID_DDLN_DT IS NOT NULL AND ORDER BY 1

SELECT TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY') AS year, P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN AS teamSn, MAX(T.TEAM_NM) AS teamNm, COUNT(*) AS joined, COUNT(R.PBANC_SN) AS resultCnt, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN R.BID_RSLT_CD = 'BR010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN P.PBANC_STTS_CD = 'PS070' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN R.BID_RSLT_CD = 'BR010' THEN R.SCSBD_AMT END), 0) AS wonAmt, AVG(R.TECH_EVL_SCR) AS avgTech FROM TB_BID_PBANC P JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_BID_RSLT R ON R.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND AND R.BID_RSLT_CD IN ('BR010', 'BR020') WHERE AND P.BID_DDLN_DT IS NOT NULL AND GROUP BY TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY'), P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN

WITH X AS ( SELECT P.PBANC_SN, P.PTCP_SHP_CD AS CD, CASE WHEN R.BID_RSLT_CD = 'BR010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS WON_YN FROM TB_BID_PBANC P
WHERE AND P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY') = #{year} ) SELECT label, resultCnt, won FROM ( SELECT C.SORT_SEQ AS ord, C.CD_NM AS label, COUNT(X.PBANC_SN) AS resultCnt, NVL(SUM(X.WON_YN), 0) AS won FROM TB_COM_CD C LEFT JOIN X ON X.CD = C.CD WHERE C.GROUP_CD = 'PTFRM' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY C.SORT_SEQ, C.CD, C.CD_NM UNION ALL SELECT 9999, '미지정', COUNT(*), NVL(SUM(X.WON_YN), 0) FROM X WHERE X.CD IS NULL HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ) ORDER BY ord

SELECT X.CAT_NM AS catNm, SUM(X.SCR) AS scoreSum, SUM(X.MX) AS maxSum, COUNT(DISTINCT X.PBANC_SN) AS bidCnt FROM ( SELECT P.PBANC_SN, NVL(UP.EVL_ARTCL_NM, A.EVL_ARTCL_NM) AS CAT_NM, MIN(NVL(UP.SORT_SEQ, A.SORT_SEQ)) AS ORD, A.EVL_SCOR_SCR AS MX, AVG(S.EVL_SCR) AS SCR FROM TB_BID_PBANC P
JOIN TB_CO_EVL_RSLT C ON C.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND C.OUR_CO_YN = 'Y' JOIN TB_EVL_CMSNR_SCR S ON S.CO_EVL_RSLT_SN = C.CO_EVL_RSLT_SN JOIN TB_EVL_ARTCL A ON A.EVL_ARTCL_SN = S.EVL_ARTCL_SN LEFT JOIN TB_EVL_ARTCL UP ON UP.EVL_ARTCL_SN = A.UP_EVL_ARTCL_SN WHERE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EVL_ARTCL K WHERE K.UP_EVL_ARTCL_SN = A.EVL_ARTCL_SN) AND P.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} AND TO_CHAR(P.BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY') = #{year} GROUP BY P.PBANC_SN, A.EVL_ARTCL_SN, NVL(UP.EVL_ARTCL_NM, A.EVL_ARTCL_NM), A.EVL_SCOR_SCR ) X WHERE X.MX > 0 GROUP BY X.CAT_NM
ORDER BY MIN(X.ORD), X.CAT_NM ORDER BY SUM(X.SCR) / SUM(X.MX), X.CAT_NM

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.ORDER_INST_NM AS orderInstNm, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, P.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS budget, R.BID_RSLT_CD AS rsltCd, RC.CD_NM AS rsltNm, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL030' AND F.LAST_YN = 'Y' AND F.DEL_YN = 'N') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS finalFileYn FROM TB_BID_PBANC P
JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD RC ON RC.GROUP_CD = 'BDRST' AND RC.CD = R.BID_RSLT_CD WHERE AND P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = #{teamSn} ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT DESC NULLS LAST, P.PBANC_SN DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.ORDER_INST_NM AS orderInstNm, P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN AS teamSn, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, PS.CD_NM AS ptcpShpNm, P.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS budget, P.BID_DDLN_DT AS bidDdlnDt, P.TECH_SCOR_SCR AS techScorScr, P.PRC_SCOR_SCR AS prcScorScr, R.BID_RSLT_CD AS rsltCd, RC.CD_NM AS rsltNm, R.EVL_RNK AS evlRnk, R.TECH_EVL_SCR AS techEvlScr, R.TECH_EVL_ORGNL_SCR AS techEvlOrgnlScr, R.PRC_EVL_SCR AS prcEvlScr, R.SNTHS_EVL_SCR AS snthsEvlScr, R.STRPT_CN AS strptCn, R.SBPT_CS_CN AS sbptCsCn, R.SPLMNT_CN AS splmntCn FROM TB_BID_PBANC P
JOIN TB_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN AND T.DEPT_CD = 'DP030' LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD PS ON PS.GROUP_CD = 'PTFRM' AND PS.CD = P.PTCP_SHP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD RC ON RC.GROUP_CD = 'BDRST' AND RC.CD = R.BID_RSLT_CD WHERE AND P.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}

SELECT F.FILE_SN AS fileSn, F.ORGNL_FILE_NM AS orgnlFileNm, F.STRG_FILE_NM AS strgFileNm, F.FILE_PATH_NM AS filePathNm, U.USER_NM AS dcsmkrNm, F.CFMTN_DT AS cfmtnDt FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = F.DCSMKR_ID WHERE F.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL030' AND F.LAST_YN = 'Y' AND F.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY F.CFMTN_DT DESC NULLS LAST, F.FILE_SN DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT F.FILE_SN AS fileSn, F.ORGNL_FILE_NM AS orgnlFileNm, F.STRG_FILE_NM AS strgFileNm, F.FILE_PATH_NM AS filePathNm, U.USER_NM AS rgtrNm, F.REG_DT AS regDt FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = F.RGTR_ID WHERE F.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL070' AND F.LAST_YN = 'Y' AND F.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY F.FILE_SN DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CO_EVL_RSLT WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND OUR_CO_YN = 'Y'

SELECT A.EVL_ARTCL_SN AS evlArtclSn, A.EVL_ARTCL_NM AS evlArtclNm, A.EVL_SCOR_SCR AS evlScorScr, S.CMSNR_NO AS cmsnrNo, S.EVL_SCR AS evlScr FROM TB_EVL_ARTCL A LEFT JOIN TB_CO_EVL_RSLT C ON C.PBANC_SN = A.PBANC_SN AND C.OUR_CO_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN TB_EVL_CMSNR_SCR S ON S.EVL_ARTCL_SN = A.EVL_ARTCL_SN AND S.CO_EVL_RSLT_SN = C.CO_EVL_RSLT_SN WHERE A.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EVL_ARTCL K WHERE K.UP_EVL_ARTCL_SN = A.EVL_ARTCL_SN) ORDER BY A.SORT_SEQ, A.EVL_ARTCL_SN, S.CMSNR_NO
